title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
summary: Internal daily calendar for the Valdena Gelato shop recording whether the shop was open on each day, and any local event that day. Catalog grain is daily with coverage declared from 2022-01-01 and still open-ended; last refreshed 2026-10-10 on a weekly cadence. Covers the shop's own location only; it does not hold sales, temperature or national holiday data. Row count (about 1500) is lower than the number of calendar days in the declared coverage, so completeness is unverified.

schema.notes: Field descriptions are one-line only in the catalog; no wiki documentation of how closures or events were recorded. Sample not possible: data is only reachable via warehouse_sql and no sample was taken.
